correctness.rationale: Uniqueness and symmetry reduce arbitrary ellipsoids to centered diagonal form with equal transverse radii. Exact support-function minimax gives the equivalent constraints b² ≤ 1/2 and a²+t(t+2)b² ≤ (1+t/2)² for every t≥0. Strict maximization of b² sqrt((t+2)²/4−t(t+2)b²) gives two branches meeting at t=1, and differentiation shows the John volume has a unique global minimum at t=2. All boundary cases t=0,1,2 and asymptotic t→∞ are covered analytically. The package verifier executes rational identities and finite support checks but is not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: A motivated complete geometric extremal problem for a continuous family interpolating centered and separated orthogonal disk hulls. The two separate thresholds t=1 (active contact) and t=2 (unique John-volume minimum when disks touch) provide a nontrivial exact phase diagram not implied by generic John uniqueness or the hull intrinsic volumes. It gives a useful exact benchmark and a complete parameter classification, rather than isolated unmotivated numeric constants.
